notes: notification_type values follow migration CHECK (BOOKING_PAID/BOOKING_EXPIRED/BOOKING_REVIEW/TURN_SOON/TURN_ARRIVED); OTP not tracked in deliveries.
OTP consumer runs on a dedicated connection with MaxRetries=0 (no retry queue).
PII AADs match User Service: users.accounts.email and otp.requested.code.
FCM sender is self-contained (OAuth2 JWT-bearer); noopPush used when FCM_CREDENTIALS_PATH unset.
